## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
min(last_15m):sum:kubernetes_state.deployment.replicas_available{__SCOPE__} by {kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace,kube_deployment} / sum:kubernetes_state.deployment.replicas_desired{__SCOPE__} by {kube_cluster_name,kube_namespace,kube_deployment} < 0.6
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** Redundancy ratios are a design contract (HA requires >60% of desired replicas to survive a node loss); this is capacity math, not a baseline.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-k8s-workload-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-k8s-workload` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `describe_workload`, `recent_pod_events`, `container_logs_tail`, `rollout_history`.

Attached to the alert automatically: kubectl describe equivalent, last 50 pod events, rollout history.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `cloud-engineering` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
